demographic_modifiers.note: Dehydration can be fatal rapidly in young children — escalate urgency
A severely malnourished child with diarrhoea requires immediate emergency referral regardless of dehydration signs
Monitor for dehydration closely — escalate faster than normal

seasonal_modifiers.note: Higher incidence May–October through contaminated water and food

explanation_template: Your symptoms may be consistent with acute diarrhoea. Staying hydrated with oral rehydration solution (ORS) is important. Seek care promptly if you cannot drink fluids, feel very weak, or symptoms worsen.
duration_note: Sudden onset of frequent watery stools indicates acute diarrhoea. If stools have been watery for more than 3 days, or if dehydration signs appear, urgency increases significantly.
